final: WITH event_counts AS (SELECT link_to_event, COUNT(*) as count FROM attendance GROUP BY link_to_event), totals AS (SELECT SUM(count) as total FROM event_counts), threshold AS (SELECT count FROM event_counts ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 9) SELECT event_counts.link_to_event, event_counts.count, CAST(event_counts.count AS REAL) / totals.total as ratio FROM event_counts CROSS JOIN totals CROSS JOIN threshold WHERE event_counts.count >= threshold.count ORDER BY ratio DESC
